question: If cot alpha=(P)/(Q), then find the value of (P cos alpha-Q sin alpha)/(P cos alpha+Q sin alpha) - (P²-Q²)/(P²+Q²)+3.
solution:
**Given:**

cot α=(P)/(Q)

**Concept Used:**

Cot α = Base/Perpendicular

Cosα/Sinα = P/Q

**Calculation:**

(P cos α-Q sin α)/(P cos α+Q sin α) - (P²-Q²)/(P²+Q²)+3

(PCotα - Q)/(P Cotα + Q) - (P²-Q²)/(P²+Q²)+3

⇒ (P² - Q²)/(P² + Q²) - (P²-Q²)/(P²+Q²)+3

⇒ 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**
